U.S. Marines with 12th Littoral Combat Team, 12th Marine Littoral Regiment, 3rd Marine Div., and Japan Air Self-Defense Force (JASDF) personnel embark a Joint Light Tactical Vehicle onto a JASDF C-130 at Naha Air Base, Japan Oct. 17, in preparation for Exercise Keen Sword.
